title: Epistola Suite Helm values
description: Partial schema: constrains operational values that have hard render-time requirements. Other values are validated by the templates.

enabled.description: Whether people may change catalogs here. false makes the installation run-only.

fileRoots.description: Directories file: catalog and code-list sources may be read from. Empty turns file: sources off.

allowedHosts.description: Host names allowed to resolve to a private address. Exact match, no wildcards.

fontCache.description: Bounds of the parsed-font cache renders share; empty keeps the application default.

maxSize.description: Estimated heap the cached faces may hold, e.g. 384MB.

maxFaces.description: Number of faces kept; 0 turns the cache off.

endpoint.description: Exchange base URL; empty means found through productDomain.

type.description: Which database the chart connects to. The chart never provisions one.

existingSecret.description: Name of the Secret holding the password; required for database.type=external.

format.description: Console output format. Plain is the default; structured formats are opt-in.

enabled.description: Render a HorizontalPodAutoscaler for the application Deployment.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Average CPU target as a percentage of the request; 0 disables the CPU metric.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Average memory target as a percentage of the request; 0 (default) disables the memory metric.

behavior.description: autoscaling/v2 HPA behavior. null leaves the Kubernetes defaults.

updateMode.description: How the Vertical Pod Autoscaler applies recommendations.

minReplicas.description: Minimum number of replicas required before VPA may evict pods.

controlledValues.description: Whether VPA controls resource requests only or requests and limits.

controlledResources.description: Resources the VPA manages. An acting VPA must not manage a resource the HPA scales on.

enabled.description: Deprecated since chart 1.1.0: use autoscaling.hpa.enabled. Still honoured and wins over autoscaling.hpa.enabled; cannot be combined with autoscaling.hpa.enabled=true.

minReplicas.description: Deprecated since chart 1.1.0: use autoscaling.hpa.minReplicas. Still honoured and wins over autoscaling.hpa.minReplicas; cannot be combined with autoscaling.hpa.enabled=true.

maxReplicas.description: Deprecated since chart 1.1.0: use autoscaling.hpa.maxReplicas. Still honoured and wins over autoscaling.hpa.maxReplicas; cannot be combined with autoscaling.hpa.enabled=true.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Deprecated since chart 1.1.0: use autoscaling.hpa.targetCPUUtilizationPercentage. Still honoured and wins over autoscaling.hpa.targetCPUUtilizationPercentage; cannot be combined with autoscaling.hpa.enabled=true.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Deprecated since chart 1.1.0: use autoscaling.hpa.targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage. Still honoured and wins over autoscaling.hpa.targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage; cannot be combined with autoscaling.hpa.enabled=true.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL. Must exceed the web server's graceful shutdown plus epistola.generation.polling.shutdown-drain-timeout.

podAntiAffinity.description: Spread application pods across nodes: soft (prefer), hard (require), or none. Ignored when affinity is set.

registrationId.description: Lowercase alphanumeric only. Rendered into an env-var segment and used verbatim as the login redirect-URI segment (/login/oauth2/code/<registrationId>); Spring lowercases the registration id from env vars, so uppercase here would diverge from the redirect URI. Provider-neutral.

silentLogin.description: Try a silent OIDC sign-in (prompt=none) before showing the login page, so users with a live identity-provider session need no click.

existingSecret.description: Name of the Secret holding the OIDC client secret; required when oidc.enabled is true.

issuerUri.description: OIDC issuer URI; required when oidc.enabled is true.

sharing.description: What this installation shares with Epistola; everything is shared by default.

versionCheck.description: Daily anonymous release and security-advisory check.

endpoint.description: Release metadata URL; empty means found through productDomain.

installationCheck.description: Daily installation check; runs only when sharing.installationId is true.

endpoint.description: Installation check URL with {id}; empty means found through productDomain.

productDomain.description: Where Epistola-operated services are found (ADR 0030): a host name, optionally with a port; never a URL.

support.description: The connection to the Epistola support service (docs/support-protocol.md).

autoRegister.description: Register on its own at the next check, and again when a claim code expires unlinked; false: an administrator presses Register.

endpoint.description: The support service's URL (its OAuth issuer); empty means found through productDomain.

services.description: The support services this installation uses until an administrator saves a selection: telemetry, requests, mirror, usage. A name the chart does not know is accepted, so values naming a retired or newer service never break an upgrade; the suite logs and ignores it.

anyOf.description: A service this chart does not know: kept, logged by the suite, not used.

tenantDefaults.description: What every tenant shares with Epistola until a tenant chooses otherwise; applied at startup only while no installation administrator has saved a setup. Empty: each tenant sets itself up.

requests.description: share: support requests go to Epistola support; no: they stay in the installation.

mirror.description: Catalog mirror: off, all (every catalog) or marked (only the catalogs a tenant marks).

backlog.description: How far back hours missed while the installation or the support service was down are still sent, as a duration such as 72h; at least an hour. Empty: 72h.

handledBy.description: Who handles new support requests until an installation administrator saves a choice: inbox (the installation's support desk) or epistola. Empty: inbox.

privacy.description: What Epistola sees of the tenants and how much telemetry carries, until an installation administrator saves them. Empty: the suite's defaults (confidential, pseudonymised).

tenantIdentity.description: confidential: each tenant as a reference; named: tenant keys as they are.

telemetry.description: pseudonymised: log messages without their values; full: as written.

enabled.description: false: nothing is sent to the mirror; withdrawals still run.
Forward logs and metrics to the support service while the telemetry scope is selected and granted.
